name: EPSY 5610
title: Applied Regression Analysis for the Education Sciences
description: Multiple regression analysis and related techniques with applications to research in education.  Topics include assumptions and inference; matrix representations; diagnostics and remedial measures; polynomial regression and interaction models; treatment of categorical independent variables, autocorrelation of errors in time series data, problems of missing values and selection bias, and logistic and ordinal regression models.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
